title: Reception of DLDedicatedMessageSegment by the UE

entities.name: DL Dedicated Message Segment
entities.description: A downlink message segment containing part of a larger RRC message that is segmented for transmission.

entities.name: RRC Message Segment Container
entities.description: Contains the actual segment data of the DL Dedicated Message Segment.

entities.name: RRC Reconfiguration Message
entities.description: An RRC message used to modify RRC configuration, processed according to clause 5.3.5.3.

entities.name: RRC Resume Message
entities.description: An RRC message used to resume an RRC connection, processed according to clause 5.3.13.4.

entities.name: All segments received condition
entities.description: Condition that checks whether all segments of a segmented message have been received by the UE.

entities.name: Store segment procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE stores the segment contained in the rrc-MessageSegmentContainer.

entities.name: Assemble message procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE assembles the complete message from all received segments.

entities.name: Discard segments procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE discards all segments after successful message assembly.

relations.description: DL Dedicated Message Segment contains the RRC Message Segment Container IE.
Store segment procedure involves storing the content from rrc-MessageSegmentContainer.
The condition that all segments have been received guards the assembly procedure.
The condition that all segments have been received guards the segment discard procedure.
Assemble message procedure may result in processing an RRCReconfiguration message.
Assemble message procedure may result in processing an RRCResume message.
